entities.summary: Giuseppe Ciarrapico was an Italian entrepreneur, publisher and politician. He was president of the football club AS Roma from 1991 and 1993, and a senator of Italy for Silvio Berlusconi's The People of Freedom party in 2008–2012. Ciarrapico was convicted and imprisoned several times due to his involvement in financial scandals.
